# CJK test fixture

`diana-cjk-test.otf` is a small, renamed glyph subset of Noto Sans CJK SC Regular,
from notofonts/noto-cjk commit f8d157532fbfaeda587e826d4cd5b21a49186f7c.
It contains only characters needed for CJK validation tests. It must not be used
as a runtime font. The upstream SIL Open Font License is included in OFL.txt.
